idea-plugin.name: Pi Coding Agent GUI
idea-plugin.description:
pi inside your IDE - a real chat panel for the pi coding agent, not another terminal tab.

This plugin runs your local pi --mode rpc and renders the conversation, tool calls, diffs and sessions in the Pi tool window. It works in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, PhpStorm, CLion, Rider and RubyMine 2024.2+ - one plugin for the whole JetBrains family. Sessions stay in pi's own ~/.pi format, models and extensions are the ones you already configured for the CLI, and nothing runs behind a proprietary backend: it is a focused alternative to heavyweight multi-engine AI plugins for people who already live in pi.

What makes it different
  • Parallel task tabs - every tab owns its own pi process, so several tasks can run at once and switching tabs never interrupts background work.
  • Steering and follow-up queues - keep typing while pi streams: Enter queues steering (delivered after the current tool call), Alt+Enter queues a follow-up, exactly like the pi TUI.
  • /btw side questions - ask something without interrupting the main task; the answer streams in a dismissible overlay and is not written into the session history.
  • Session tree with fork - create, switch, rename, delete, fork and inspect branches, one row per user message.
  • IDE-native tool output - tool cards for file reads, edits and terminal runs; click a diff to jump to the exact editor line.
  • Shell in the composer - ! cmd keeps the output in the LLM context, !! cmd keeps it out, rendered as a terminal-style card.
Everything else
  • Streaming replies, thinking blocks, token usage and a context meter.
  • Model and thinking-level pickers in the footer: search, provider grouping, Set as default, and custom models appended to ~/.pi/agent/models.json without touching existing fields.
  • Manual and automatic compaction, aborting automatic retries.
  • Slash commands and project-file completion with / and @.
  • Editor selection and console output attached as context; files, URLs, terminal output and diff lines open straight in the IDE.
  • Image paste in the composer.
  • Chat panel in English (default) and Simplified Chinese, switchable in settings.
  • Full-text search in the transcript (Ctrl+F), with case, whole-word and regex modes.
  • pi extension dialogs, notifications, status text and status-bar widgets.
  • Light and dark IDE themes, accent color, chat font size, wheel sensitivity, optional chat background image.
  • pi CLI path, Node.js runtime, proxy injection (subprocess only), diagnostic log directory, completion sound, and all panel shortcuts rebindable in the IDE keymap.
Install in three steps:
1. npm install -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent (or use the official installer at pi.dev).
2. Install this plugin from the Marketplace.
3. Open the Pi tool window (Ctrl+Alt+K) and start a task.

Requirements: Node.js 22.19.0 or later, and the pi CLI installed separately. The plugin finds pi in your configured path, the bundled copy, ~/.pi/agent/install, or the npm global prefix, and Node.js from settings/PATH with a fallback to pi's standalone Node.

中文：把 pi coding agent 接进 JetBrains IDE 的图形面板 - 多任务标签并行、会话树 fork、/btw 侧问、steering 队列、diff 一键跳转编辑器、模型与思考级别切换，会话保持 pi 原生格式。

Source code, issue tracker and full documentation: github.com/Cyber0xFE/pi-jetbrains-gui
